description: The agent must: (1) Read and parse the raw emotional draft from the specified path. (2) Produce a `polished_communication.md` file using the exact 3-section Markdown template structure from SKILL.md. (3) Section 1 must contain intent extraction, real business goals, risk diagnosis, and strategy advice. (4) Section 2 must contain all four plans A/B/C/D with correct tone differentiation: Plan A uses cooperative/gentle 'Yes, and...' framing; Plan B applies the SBI model with explicit deadline/responsibility/precondition confirmation (留痕意识); Plan C uses pyramid/conclusion-first structure AND provides 2-3 options WITH pros and cons for the leader to choose from (the key proprietary trap — generic agents will write a single narrative); Plan D is client-facing, shows empathy and a timeline, and critically must NOT reveal any internal team conflicts or blame. (5) Section 3 must analyze the techniques used and provide next-step action advice. (6) Fill-in placeholders must use [ ] format. (7) Overall language in rewritten plans must use '我们' more than accusatory '你', reflecting the de-emotionalization principle.
